la_vs_le_mapping.la_pattern: LA defines broad analog/digital widget set including AMIC, VA AMIC, RX dummy, HPH/AUX/EAR, and TX/RX dummy endpoints.
la_vs_le_mapping.le_pattern: LE defines equivalent families (AMIC/DMIC/RX/HPH/AUX/EAR) with simplified organization and event callbacks.

la_vs_le_mapping.la_pattern: LA route map includes VA_AMIC mixers and WCD_TX_OUTPUT/WCD_RX_DUMMY staging nodes.
la_vs_le_mapping.le_pattern: LE route map keeps equivalent ADC/DMIC and HPH/AUX/EAR topology with a smaller route graph.

la_vs_le_mapping.la_pattern: LA exposes extensive channel-map and switch controls including HPH compander, ADC/DMIC maps, and LDOH/BCS toggles.
la_vs_le_mapping.le_pattern: LE exposes similar switch/volume/ch-map controls but with streamlined callbacks and shared helper usage.

la_vs_le_mapping.la_pattern: LA event handlers embed vendor status bits and custom callbacks around PA and watchdog behavior.
la_vs_le_mapping.le_pattern: LE event handlers drive class-H and MBHC through shared APIs and standard component field writes.

la_vs_le_mapping.la_pattern: LA HPH PA callbacks include delay logic plus vendor status mask operations.
la_vs_le_mapping.le_pattern: LE HPH PA callbacks use wcd_clsh_ctrl_set_state, wcd_clsh_set_hph_mode, and MBHC event notifications via shared APIs.

la_vs_le_mapping.la_pattern: LA AUX callback drives watchdog and class-H through vendor state handling.
la_vs_le_mapping.le_pattern: LE AUX callback keeps watchdog + class-H state transitions with shared class-H control object.

la_vs_le_mapping.la_pattern: LA EAR path multiplexes RX source and controls gain override with vendor event sequencing.
la_vs_le_mapping.le_pattern: LE EAR callback has same functional intent but uses component field helpers and class-H state API.

la_vs_le_mapping.la_pattern: LA uses AMIC mixers + HDR mux controls with VA AMIC parallel widgets.
la_vs_le_mapping.le_pattern: LE keeps ADC/HDR/AMIC mux graph without LA-specific VA AMIC duplication.

la_vs_le_mapping.la_pattern: LA provides DMIC1..DMIC8 mixer/output routes tied to tx channel mapping.
la_vs_le_mapping.le_pattern: LE provides DMIC1..DMIC8 routes with equivalent mixer structure and SDW channel handling.

la_vs_le_mapping.la_pattern: LA exposes HPHL/HPHR compander switch controls via local callbacks.
la_vs_le_mapping.le_pattern: LE keeps HPHL/HPHR compander controls and invokes LE callback implementations.

la_vs_le_mapping.la_pattern: LA exposes CLSH switch but ties event control to legacy class-H APIs and status bits.
la_vs_le_mapping.le_pattern: LE exposes CLSH switch and routes behavior through shared wcd-clsh-v2 controller.

likely_reusable_control_categories: DAPM event-driven class-H/MBHC hooks using shared helper APIs
requires_datasheet_or_runtime_confirmati: Exact channel count and SDW port/channel mapping for each control
PA timing values and watchdog sequencing sensitivity
Class-H state behavior differences that may depend on codec version/base
Any board-dependent VA mic or external mux topology
must_be_omitted_unless_evidenced: LA-only VA_AMIC duplication if not present in WCD9378 topology
Board-specific route nodes or workaround controls
rules_for_wcd9378.fail_closed_statement: Topology categories are reusable patterns only. Runtime function (playback/capture/mute behavior) remains FAIL_CLOSED until hardware validation.
